en.hubeali:
A nmber of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Abu Jameela, from Muhammad Al Halby, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Made a resemblance of my<sup>saww</sup> community for me<sup>saww</sup> in the clay and Taught me<sup>saww</sup> their names just as He<sup>azwj</sup> had Taught Adam<sup>saww</sup> the names, all of them.
So the owners of the flags passed by me<sup>saww</sup>, and they sought Forgiveness for Ali<sup>asws</sup> and his<sup>asws</sup> Shias.
My<sup>saww</sup> Lord<sup>azwj</sup> Promised me<sup>saww</sup> a characteristic with regards to the Shias of Ali<sup>asws</sup>’.

It was said, ‘O Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>! And what is it?’ He<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The Forgiveness for the ones from them who believe and that neither a minor (sin) nor a major (sin) of theirs would be left, and the evil deeds would be changed to good deeds’.
